# Pull Request Template

## Description

Please describe the changes you've made in this pull request.

## Type of Change

Please delete the options that do not apply:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring

## Checklist

Please check the boxes that apply to your PR:

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix works
- [ ] I have added tests for new functionality
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass
- [ ] I have updated the SECURITY.md if applicable
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have linted my code
- [ ] I have updated the environment variables in .env.example if applicable

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the pull request here.
